summary: Short, clean meeting (23 min). Chair, City Manager, Susan Penner, Zwaagstra and Siemens are solid. The two single-turn male councillors are uncertain: F (seconder slot, Damian Penner, medium) and H (Pick Up and Walk volunteer, possibly Bill Hiebert, low; AssemblyAI says Jake Hiebert).
